title.suggested: Bartender breaks prankster's jaw at Allen's saloon

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Matthew Groves, a hanger-on at Tom Allen's Market Street saloon, had his jaw slightly fractured by bartender Andrew Flynn after pulling chairs from under patrons.
